subject: Vendor portal kickstart: credentialing & evidence window
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@vendr.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal access & initial evidence plan

Hi David,

Thanks for agreeing to get Vendr set up with Redwood's security profile — I pulled together a short onboarding plan to get the portal populated and evidence attached for the SOC 2 + CAIQ items you flagged during the call.

High-level ask: can you confirm a 48-hour window next week for a focused upload run (we typically call this an "evidence sprint") where your team will (a) accept the portal invite, (b) complete the short Q&A, and (c) upload artifacts for mapping.

What we need from Redwood to start:
- Portal administrator (email) to receive invite
- SSO type (SAML/OIDC) and SP metadata if you want SSO now
- Any NDA/PO we should have on file before artifacts are uploaded

Attaching the standard Vendr manifest for reference — it maps each CAIQ question to recommended artifact types. I can also provision a temporary pre-signed S3 upload if you prefer.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_manifest.csv (CSV)

Would Monday or Tuesday next week work for the 48-hour window?

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Security Onboarding — Vendr
alex.moreno@vendr.com
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@vendr.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal access & initial evidence plan

Alex — thanks, this looks good.

Quick answers up front:
- Portal admin: I will accept the invite. For ongoing uploads, Irene will be the evidence steward (irene_choi@redwoodinference.com).
- SSO: we prefer SAML. I'll loop Karthik to provide SP metadata and help with provisioning.
- NDA: we have a standard mutual NDA; I'll attach a copy here for your legal team to review. If you need DocuSign, send the link.

Irene / Priyom — can you confirm SOC 2 artifacts we can surface quickly (system configs, org chart, recent pen test summary)? I can handoff an internal sprint for the 48-hour upload window.

Attachment: redwood_sg_scan_summary.pdf (pdf)

Proposed windows: Tue 2029-07-23 08:00-20:00 PDT (48-hour split) or Thu 2029-07-25 08:00-20:00 PDT. Either works for us but prefer Tue.

David Kim
Head of Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwoodinference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal access & initial evidence plan

David — putting a short checklist together so the sprint is predictable. See the index attached (SOC 2 -> artifact mapping + suggested filenames).

Minimum artifacts we'll aim to upload during the sprint:
- SOC 2 report (redacted) or SOC 2 type II attestation PDF
- Penetration test executive summary
- Network diagram (current)
- IAM policy snippets / RBAC table (CSV)
- Encryption-at-rest config snapshot (KMS key metadata)

Priyom — I'll need the latest CAIQ mapping you maintain (we should keep a two-column mapping: CAIQ question -> local artifact). Can you confirm you can produce the soc2_artifact_index.xlsx by EOD Monday?

Attachment: soc2_artifact_index.xlsx (xlsx)

If Vendr can provide a pre-signed upload URL cadence, that will help us avoid throttling the S3 bucket from our side.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@vendr.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vendr Portal Bot <noreply@vendr.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2029 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal access & initial evidence plan

Thanks David / Irene — all great.

Portal access: I sent an invite to david_kim@redwoodinference.com from invite@vendr.com (subject: "Vendr portal access for Redwood Inference"). Please accept that invite before the sprint.

SSO: we support SAML. You can upload SP metadata at https://vendr.com/portal/sso-setup or paste the metadata XML into the tenant settings page after accepting the invite. Karthik, if you want, I can enable a short-lived test account to validate the SSO assertion.

Upload options: we have three options — (1) direct file upload through portal UI (recommended for small batches), (2) pre-signed S3 manifest (we'll provide a presign link per artifact), or (3) API bulk ingest (for partners). Given you mentioned a 48-hour sprint, I'd recommend option (2). If you confirm, I will generate presigned links 24 hours before the start window.

NDA: please sign via this DocuSign link (one-click): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&id=XYZ-123

Portal invite link: https://vendr.com/portal/invite/abcdef123456

Attachment: none

— Alex
Alex Moreno
Security Onboarding — Vendr
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal access & initial evidence plan

All — I accepted the task to produce SAML SP metadata and confirm I will upload it to the portal by EOD Monday (2029-07-22).

Operational notes for the sprint:
- I'll provision a temporary service account for the portal admin with scoped rights (upload-only) and rotate credentials after the sprint.
- Suggested upload cadence: 500 files per 4 hours to avoid portal throttling; Irene and Priyom will prioritize SOC 2 and pen test artifacts early in the window.
- I've scheduled a 30-minute kickoff on Tue 2029-07-23 08:00 PDT — calendar invite will follow.

Calendar link: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/event/meet-20290723-sprint-kickoff

Thanks — Karthik
